title: One Capture, Two Ways to Teach the Product
description: A staged Rally HQ tournament journey becomes both a click-through guide and a playable video. The useful part is not the file conversion; it is keeping the teaching surface attached to real product state and one shared catalogue of reader journeys.
cardDesc: One staged Rally HQ journey, shown as both a click-through guide and a playable video — with the evidence boundary intact.
principles: Capture a real product journey before turning it into teaching material.
Use one named catalogue for the roles and labels shown across demo surfaces.
Treat staged output as a demonstration, not evidence of customer activity or complete validation.
